results.title: Trump's tariffs put Republican support at risk
results.description: Job losses in battleground states have led to political shifts among workers who previously supported Republicans. This includes individuals affected by President Trump's tariffs, which some blame for layoffs and company closures. Many voters are expressing dissatisfaction with the economic impact of these trade policies. Democratic candidates are likely to benefit from this backlash against tariffs in forthcoming elections.
